active.policy: Preserve continuous legacy matching; displacement/shape/mutual-margin guard after >150ms gap; abstain when established tracks compete
active.gap_cues: Reject if BOTH displacement and shape disagree; either cue alone can reflect partial visibility
active.conflict_policy: Margin only against established competitors whose nearest eligible proposal is the same column

parent_shape_and_dormant_params: Byte-identical parent/config.json; shape filter remains mesh-only experimental
ambiguity_policy: Retain unknown measured proposal track_id=-1 when established tracks compete or gap reassociation is ambiguous; no synthetic observations
legacy_full_gate: Also report original strict fragmentation-reduction gate against baseline; do not relabel it if it fails
validation_limit: Dataset roles in frozen manifest: seeds42/43 are regression; unseen seed44 only after final engine freeze; same layout/backend
